acceptance_criteria.assertion: GIS loads with 21 nodes and no excluded infrastructure features
Graph has at least one edge and preserves every source GIS ID
All 12 ordered events have an input, timestamp, target, expected graph effect, and expected dashboard effect
Repeated drone bytes are rejected by SHA-256 exact deduplication
The three registered real ISBDA images produce only Slight, Severe, or Debris labels through the committed YOLO model
Severe damage or degraded telemetry increases target-node stress over baseline
Checkpoint-backed TGNN emits a finite risk value for every graph node
Dashboard displays source status, event progression, affected nodes, and ranked risks

non_claims: Simulated event values are not field measurements.
Official ISBDA labels are ground truth; recorded selection inference is model output and not a model-accuracy claim.
ISBDA capture locations are not provided; all Louisiana GPS assignments are simulated and explicitly marked.
